capacity_scope: named registered maximum-width/load source in each family, same platform/stage; bank5 capture count<=2048, input capacity<=640; stop on any failure
source: actual fifth kept DFF bank and fifth top-level observation, with per-bank Q-D and mapped-instance witnesses
independence: fresh F5 load/source contexts at already exposed widths; measured extrapolation beyond trainF1/F3, not unseen-width generalization
SDC: exact original four target points per family; no posterior Tmin adjustment
mapping: one t0 map per source; later targets reuse exact mapped Verilog, fresh SDC/ODB and physical chain
label_protocol: versioned arithmetic-model-labels-v2 permits exactly registered five-bank topology; original four-bank producer remains frozen
synth_observation: generic synth precursor without node labels, then same-ODB labeled snapshot; extra observation charged, no repeated mapping or physical optimization
